bsis.description: Monthly full balance sheet, one column per line item (pivoted from Oracle's long format).

bsis.name: capital_adequacy
bsis.description: Monthly capital adequacy ratios (Tier 1, Total Capital, Leverage).

bsis.description: Monthly credit exposure by economic sector, with performing/non-performing breakdown.

bsis.name: earnings
bsis.description: Monthly earnings/profitability metrics.

bsis.name: income_statement
bsis.description: Monthly income statement, monthly + year-to-date amount per line item (pivoted).

bsis.name: lcr
bsis.description: Monthly Liquidity Coverage Ratio (Basel III).

bsis.name: liquidity_compliance
bsis.description: Daily liquid-assets-to-demand-liabilities compliance ratio.
bsis.suggested_analysis: Daily liquidity compliance trend, breach alerts.

bsis.description: Daily net open foreign-exchange position.

bsis.name: nsfr
bsis.description: Monthly Net Stable Funding Ratio (Basel III).

bsis.description: Monthly market risk sensitivity measures.

bsis.description: Daily statutory minimum reserve (SMR) compliance per institution.
bsis.suggested_analysis: Day-to-day SMR breach detection, compliance trend.
